summary: Iter175 frontend-only validation of three new collaboration features. PASS: (a) logged-out /contribute?share=<id> redirects to /auth/login and stashes pending_contribute_share in AsyncStorage; (b) ShareStepModal 'Sent' tab on a live_sync share renders the green 'Live video session · screen-share on' card with the meeting URL (https://meet.jit.si/JELCOS-…), Copy link + Invite more buttons; tapping Invite more reveals the emails TextInput + 'Send invites + meeting link' button, and submitting calls POST /api/shared-steps/{id}/add-recipients → 200; (c) /tools/collaborate Step 1 regression — wizard opens with all three module-type chips (MyDezider, Pros & Cons, Solution Finder), flow list renders, Next button present. FAIL (HIGH, two related root-causes that BLOCK the deep-link feature end-to-end): (1) /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx lines 62-69 — when the freshly-logged-in user is adminLike (role=admin / super_admin / co_admin / is_admin), the screen unconditionally router.replace('/admin') and NEVER calls getPostAuthRoute(); the pending_contribute_share is therefore stranded in AsyncStorage and the contributor is NOT auto-returned to /contribute. Because the supplied test contributor admin@test.com has role=admin, the entire 'emailed/WhatsApp deep link → signup→auto-return' flow is broken for admin-role contributors. (2) /app/frontend/app/contribute.tsx lines 66-76 — the useEffect reads isAuthenticated from authStore but does NOT wait for isLoading=false; on a hard browser load of /contribute?share=… the store hydrates async, so the effect fires once with isAuthenticated=false, stashes the share and pushes /auth/login even when the user actually has a valid session. After auth hydrates the login screen's adminLike branch then drops them on /admin (compounded by bug 1). Net effect on web: /contribute is effectively unreachable via a cold deep-link click for admin/super_admin contributors. As a side-effect Tests 2/3/4 (OTP card render + owner-bypass) could not be exercised through the UI because /contribute always bounces; the OTP card markup itself is correct in source (contribute.tsx lines 122-165 — verify card with channel chips, 'Send code via Email' button, 6-digit TextInput, 'Verify & continue' button; routeToStep calls /shared-steps/{id}/open or router.replace('/prr/<id>?contribShareId=...&contribStep=…')).

ui_bugs.issue: Lines 62-69 unconditionally route adminLike users to /admin and bypass getPostAuthRoute(). pending_contribute_share (and pending_share_token) deep-links are dropped for any contributor whose role is admin / super_admin / co_admin / is_admin. Fix: call getPostAuthRoute() FIRST and only fall back to '/admin' if the helper returned '/(tabs)' (i.e. no deep-link pending). Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx:62-69

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect at lines 66-76 acts on isAuthenticated without first waiting for authStore isLoading=false. On a cold web load the effect fires with isAuthenticated=false → stashes pending_contribute_share and router.replace('/auth/login') even when the user has a valid session. Fix: pull isLoading from useAuthStore and early-return while isLoading is true (similar to _layout.tsx:279). Reference: /app/frontend/app/contribute.tsx:23,66-76

rca_of_issue:
Root cause #1 (login.tsx:62-69): the early-2025 'adminLike fast-path' to /admin was added before the iter175 contribute-deep-link helper existed; nobody updated the branch to defer to getPostAuthRoute() for adminLike users. Fix: invoke getPostAuthRoute() first; route adminLike to /admin only when the helper returned the default '/(tabs)'.

Root cause #2 (contribute.tsx:23,66-76): the deep-link screen treats `!isAuthenticated` as 'logged-out' the moment it mounts, but on a hard web load the zustand authStore hasn't hydrated yet, so the effect fires before checkAuth() resolves. Fix: pull isLoading from useAuthStore and `if (isLoading) return;` at the top of the effect, mirroring the pattern in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx line 279.

Both fixes are small (≤5 lines each) and unblock TEST 2/3/4 from the review request. The live-sync Sent-tab flow and the wizard regression both PASS as-is.
